how.kicker: Useful work / checked byte for byte
how.title: Shorter syntax. Identical world.
how.step1Body: Import the current format, canonicalize final semantics, and bind it to a domain-separated SHA-256 semantic root.
how.step2Body: Typed mutations and spatial crossover rearrange bounded BOX, RUN, EXTRUDE, symmetry, and related instructions.
how.step3Body: A canonical residual adds, restores, clears, or repaints every remaining mismatch, never a visual approximation.
how.step4Body: The verifier re-decodes bytes, costs, hashes, limits, and every voxel. Only an exact, strictly smaller result is accepted.

spec.title: A bounded codec, not a hash lottery
spec.terrainBody: preserves the sorted ChunkBroken deletion set.
spec.buildingBody: preserves the final NCM voxel/material map.
spec.forgedBody: preserves equipment identity, full geometry, paint, and grip.
spec.encodingBody: hashes one particular byte representation. Different exact encodings can share the former and must differ in the latter.
spec.limitsBody: No floating point, recursion, jumps, unbounded loops, dynamic code, clocks, or trusted result statistics. Canonical varints and checked arithmetic are mandatory.
spec.boundaryBody: This preview has no wallet, RPC, reward, pool, leaderboard, or deployed Solana PoUW verifier. A chain adapter interface is reserved; chain claims are not.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.exactAnswer: No. The verifier compares canonical semantics and every coordinate/material identity. One changed voxel, material, immutable forge field, or grip changes the result.
faq.optimalQuestion: Does the miner prove a globally shortest encoding?
faq.optimalAnswer: No. It proves that one candidate is exact, bounded, and strictly shorter than the incumbent. No improvement found is a valid result.
faq.uploadAnswer: No. Files are passed directly to local Web Workers. The page includes no upload endpoint, telemetry, third-party CDN, GitHub API request, wallet, or RPC client.
faq.negativeQuestion: Why can a profile show negative savings?
faq.negativeAnswer: Some existing NCM3 or NCF1 assets are already highly compact. The demo reports that honestly and never relabels equal or larger bytes as storage savings.
